tax_litigation.as_last_disclosed: A Show Cause Notice was issued on the Company’s Maharashtra ISD registration, alleging that the services were not qualified as common services. The disputed amount was Tax of Rs.17,29,42,824, Interest of Rs.10,89,96,623 and Penalty of Rs.1,72,94,281. An order was passed by the Dy. Commissioner on 30-12-2025 with nil demand of tax, interest and penalty. However, in the same order, the ISD distribution and eligibility of certain ITC has been disputed for distribution of excess credit. The Company has decided to file an appeal against this order.
tax_litigation.status: The Company tried to file an appeal online in order to challenge the Show Cause Notice. However, due to some technical glitches on the GST portal, the Company could not succeed in filing the appeal online. As a suitable option, the Company then filed a Writ Petition on 27-03-2026 with the Hon’ble Bombay High Court. Subsequently, on 13-04-2026, the Judicial Clerk has accepted appeal in manual mode. Appeal is yet to be heard.
